# axm auth

Manage registry authentication.

## When to use

Use this command family when signing in, signing out, or managing tokens.

## Usage

```bash
axm auth <subcommand> [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](global-flags).

## Examples

**Sign in to the default registry**

```bash
axm auth login
```

**Check who you're authenticated as**

```bash
axm auth whoami
```

**Print your auth token for scripting**

```bash
axm auth token
```

## Subcommands

| Command                        | Summary                             |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------- |
| [axm auth login](auth/login)   | Sign in to a registry               |
| [axm auth logout](auth/logout) | Sign out of a registry              |
| [axm auth whoami](auth/whoami) | Show current authenticated identity |
| [axm auth token](auth/token)   | Output current auth token to stdout |

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
